messages:
alice_sales: Quick one PolarisEdge POC wants to close today. They sent a redlined MSA and an AP requirement: PO number on signed orderform, SOC2 + pen test summary attestation, tenant-key isolation statement, and a hard 30-day erase SLA. Can legal/procurement triage?

nora_legal: Send their redline pls. 30-day for all copies is unlikely; we usually do 30 days for customer-visible data, 90 days for backups/archives. Also need to review any expanded liability or indemnity edits.

alice_sales: Uploaded: Polaris_MSA_Redline_Apr2026.pdf. They swapped our DPA with their own schedule and added a requirement to list subprocessors inline on the orderform. They flagged net14 payment.

paul_procure: PO field + billing block ok. Finance prefers net30; net14 is fast but doable with prepay or credit approval. Listing subprocessors inline is sensitive; we keep a subprocessor schedule link. Can we ask them to accept a schedule reference?

chris_sre: For KMS attestation: we can state tenant logical separation and KMS provider. We don't offer tenant-specific HSM for hosted. If they require HSM, we need Private deployment + pricing conversation. We can also provide a pen test summary redacted.

nora_legal: Proposed counterpoints: 1) Deletion: 30 days for customer data, 90 for backups. 2) Subprocessors: schedule link + 30 days' notice. 3) KMS attestation factual only (no added warranty). 4) Payment: net14 acceptable if prepay or finance sign-off. I'll draft a short DPA counter and attestation.

alice_sales: Can you paste the attestation text so I can send to procurement? Polaris wants to include it in their procurement binder.

nora_legal: Draft attestation: ```
KMS Attestation: Redwood Inference confirms that in its hosted service customer encryption keys are logically isolated per customer and are managed using industry-standard KMS controls. Keys are not retained in plaintext. This attestation is informational and does not create additional contractual liability under the MSA.
```

paul_procure: I'll prepare the orderform template with a PO number field, invoice-to/remit-to blocks, and a reference to the subprocessor schedule URL. I'll set payment terms to net30 with a note: net14 available with prepayment or finance approval.

alice_sales: Sent counter + orderform to PolarisEdge and asked them to initial retained redlines. Also asked if a provisional PO (PO to be inserted after finance issues code) could be used by AP while we finalize.

polaris (via alice_sales): They viewed the doc and said their AP needs PO on signed docs; provisional PO not allowed. They will initial redlines if we accept the 30/90 deletion split and provide SOC2 + pen test summary and the KMS attestation. They said net14 is preferred but can accept net30 for pilot.

chris_sre: We'll attach SOC2 redacted and a one-page pen test summary. That should satisfy procurement. Question: do they need subprocessors in the orderform or just schedule link?

paul_procure: Confirmed: schedule link is fine. We'll include a checkbox "subprocessor schedule attached at [URL]". That keeps orderform clean.

nora_legal: Great. Sent final redline with KMS attestation and deletion split. Asked them to initial any language they want to keep.

docusign-bot: DocuSign envelope created: "Redwood  PolarisEdge POC - MSA & Orderform" (env: p0l1s2). Recipients: polaris_signer, alice_sales.

alice_sales: Sent and pinged Polaris for initials. Fingers crossed for EOD. :crossed_fingers:

docusign-bot: Envelope viewed by polaris_signer at 2135792499.

polaris (via alice_sales): They initialled and signed the MSA + orderform, included their PO number on the form.

docusign-bot: Envelope completed at 2135792505. Signed MSA, DPA, and orderform uploaded to deals/PolarisEdge/2026/attachments.

alice_sales: Amazing closing notes: attach SOC2 + pen test summary to CRM, route to finance for invoice matching PO, and schedule quick follow-up call to discuss Private deployment if they ever need tenant HSMs. Thanks all. :tada:
